body:
Maps existing bounded background diagnostic labels, metric aggregation and transaction-fenced storage on the activity controls census dependency. Records runtime snapshot and fixed bucket/shard edges without changing service behavior. The census remains partial.

Validation: component checker and 242 boundary/integration tests passed. Focused diagnostics tests: three passed and two failed (expected engine_game versus actual other; runbook snapshot includes unsupported labels). The prior 24 PGN activity-scope failures, 19 earlier failures and ten missing-adapter errors remain unresolved. Native and live behavior were not qualified.

## Summary by Sourcery

Add bounded background metrics ownership to the component census without changing runtime behavior.

New Features:
- Map the bounded background metrics diagnostic and storage files into the component census.

Enhancements:
- Track background metrics ownership and enforce its census coverage alongside existing component scopes.

Documentation:
- Document the new background metrics census and its remaining validation limitations.

Tests:
- Extend component census integration tests for background metrics discovery, ownership validation, and scope removal.
title: Map background metrics ownership
